title: Remote viewing Joan of Arc

tellings.quote: Oh, things like um Jon of Arc.

plain: In the 1980s, the Army sergeant Lyn Buchanan says, he and his fellow remote viewers, people trained to try to describe distant places, people and events with the mind alone, were sometimes given targets from deep history, such as Joan of Arc, the French heroine. Buchanan says he took part himself, and mentions Joan of Arc only briefly as an example of what they were asked to look at.
